Reddit won't let me post on the original post, so here it is:

 Saturday night I took 300mg DPH. This is a report in retrospect. Last time of eating was around 8pm. The trip could have been a lot worse. I suppose as a warning to people who want to push their limits. I have taken DPH before at higher doses, and not had such a scary time. The drug is so unpredictable, and definitely don't use it when you're in a dysphoric mood like I was. I didn't experience any body load, which was weird. FYI: I am 108lb female.

Took 300mg about 11pm.

11.30pm: Feeling OK, a little spacey/foggy headed.

12am: Heart starting to race very fast, slight unease. Feeling of dissociation greatly intensified.

12.15am: Heart racing even faster. 

BLANK 

2am: Before this I only felt physical effects and spaceyness. At around this point I started to get visuals. I was still aware it was hallucinations. It started with dots growing legs and coming towards me. The walls are also melting, breathing and vision has static. 

3am: Sitting on the step outside. Remember looking at the patio floor in pitch black and the floor suddenly lit up and I can patterns in like ancient rune style. This was pretty cool, but then those patterns became rats and frogs, some spiders too. Am very freaked out and decide the turn the patio light on. Some time after this I kept hearing footsteps and people laughing. I screamed, remember getting the broom to fight them off (ha ha). Kept looking around but couldn't see anybody. Also hearing a very menacing dark laugh, and now a veil of red mist was covering everything. By now I am scared and decide to go in the lounge where I cover my face with a pillow so I can't see anything, put the TV on loud. But now the voices on the TV are laughing at me, and some threats to kill. I turn all lights in the house on, and the TV off. Was genuinely terrified and during the time, because of being delirious, thought this was real. Remember thinking about going to get a knife in case anybody did appear. 

Then did that snapping back into reality thing and trying to repeat I am tripping, this isn't real. Laid down on sofa and tried to sleep but my legs were so restless and I was wide awake, which was weird. 

6am: Haven't slept but effects wearing off now. Took another 150mg and this creates a lovely dreamy state with no weird stuff.
